race.description: Maurice Monckton Wtc Thanks You For 12 Years Hcp (Bm68)
race.comment: MISS DE MEDICI (6) got well back over 1350m at Doomben last time and never threatened, eventually finishing 4.5 lengths away in 11th. Finds a much more suitable contest and can take this out. ROTHGO (3) finished fourth last start over 1200m at Toowoomba after racing on the pace for much of the way. Can play a major role in the outcome. WOLFGANG (2) saves his best form for this distance range and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley. Shouldn't be discounted lightly. NORTH COURT (7) resumes here but showed enough when last in work to warrant consideration in a race like this. Revved up for this with a recent trial placing and can feature with the 3kg claim.
